2607.05876.title: Think Before You Grid-Search: Floor-First Triage for LLM Serving
2607.05876.paper_summary:
LLM serving optimization typically benchmarks many configurations and reaches for heavy profilers when latency targets are missed. We argue for the reverse discipline: estimation is the analytical layer of profiling -- without it, optimization degenerates to grid search. Floor First is a residual-driven triage workflow. Each decode step is modeled as a five-dimensional resource vector (HBM bytes, FLOPs, network bytes, network messages, KV capacity); summing within a resource and maximizing across resources gives an optimistic floor, the plain sum a pessimistic one. Where a measurement lands inside this [max, sum] interval reads out overlap quality before any profiler is opened, and profilers escalate only on residuals above a stated threshold. Deployment alternatives are compared by wall ordering -- which resource wall binds first as load grows -- rather than by point benchmarks. The account is compositional: new attention or state-space variants enter by declaring one module, and the workflow ships as a zero-dependency calculator plus an agent skill that enforces the discipline in agentic optimization loops.
  As a case study we analyze a DeepSeek-V3.2-style 671B MoE/MLA model on 16 NVIDIA H20 GPUs, whose ridge point of ~74 FLOP/byte (vs ~590 for H100) makes it an extreme decode-oriented part. The floors show TP16 decoding is KV-capacity-limited to ~70 concurrent 8K requests; sparse attention removes the KV-bandwidth term but not the capacity wall; an EP16+DP-attention layout accepts slightly worse same-batch weight traffic for an order-of-magnitude higher capacity wall (~644) -- while single-stream latency favors TP by 2.4x. The layout judgment is thus a computable function of the operating point, explaining why production deployments on identical hardware have shipped opposite attention layouts.
2607.05876.paper_summary_zh:
LLM 服務優化通常會基準多種配置，並在延遲目標未達成時尋求重型分析工具。我們主張相反的紀律：估算是分析層的分析 -- 沒有它，優化退化為網格搜索。Floor First 是一種基於剩餘驅動的分類工作流程。每個解碼步驟被建模為五維資源向量（HBM 字節、FLOPs、網絡字節、網絡消息、KV 容量）；在資源內求和並在資源間最大化給出樂觀的底線，普通和則給出悲觀的底線。測量在這個 [max, sum] 區間內的位置在任何分析工具打開之前讀取重疊質量，而分析工具僅在超過指定閾值的剩餘上升級。部署選擇通過牆排序進行比較 -- 隨著負載增長，哪個資源牆最先綁定 -- 而不是通過點基準。這個帳戶是組合性的：新的注意力或狀態空間變體通過聲明一個模塊進入，工作流程作為零依賴計算器加上一個在代理優化迴圈中強制紀律的代理技能發送。  
作為案例研究，我們分析了一個在 16 個 NVIDIA H20 GPU 上運行的 DeepSeek-V3.2 風格的 671B MoE/MLA 模型，其峭壁點約為 ~74 FLOP/字節（相比 H100 的 ~590），使其成為一個極端的解碼導向部分。底線顯示 TP16 解碼的 KV 容量限制為約 70 個同時的 8K 請求；稀疏注意力移除了 KV 帶寬項，但未移除容量牆；EP16+DP-注意力佈局接受略差的同批權重流量，以獲得高出一個數量級的容量牆（約 ~644） -- 而單流延遲則偏向 TP 2.4 倍。因此，佈局判斷是一個可計算的操作點函數，解釋了為什麼在相同硬體上生產部署已經發送了相反的注意力佈局。
2607.05876.author: Yihua Liu et.al.
